notes:
It reads the panels, not the credits.

From listening to a chapter end to end — this is the first round of fixes from that.

• No more title card. Every chapter opened by reading the series name, then said it again over the first panel. Both gone.
• No more studio credit read out as gibberish at the end of a chapter.
• Lines stop being clipped. A short line could have its "finished" signal missed, and the stale signal then cut the next line off a word or two in. Every clip also ends with a beat of silence now, so nothing gets trimmed off the last syllable.
• Swearing is spoken. If the page bleeps it, you hear the word rather than the engine spelling out a symbol.

Still on the list from that listen: sound effects, and characters changing voice mid-scene.
